benchmarks.name: LMArena Text
benchmarks.caveat: Blind head-to-head votes. Measures what people prefer reading, which tracks style as well as correctness.

benchmarks.name: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index
benchmarks.caveat: A composite of ten evaluations Artificial Analysis runs itself, under one harness. Only fully evaluated models are indexed: rows the site stars as estimates (not every component run independently, or based on the lab’s own claims) are left out. Several components (Terminal-Bench among them) are also indexed on their own boards, so the two overlap.

benchmarks.name: Terminal-Bench
benchmarks.caveat: Scores a model plus its agent scaffold (Codex, Claude Code, Grok Build). The scaffold is part of the result, not a constant.

benchmarks.name: ARC-AGI-2
benchmarks.caveat: Reported per reasoning-effort tier. The same model spans a wide range across tiers; the highest published tier is indexed and recorded beside the score.

benchmarks.name: LiveBench
benchmarks.caveat: Questions are refreshed to resist contamination. The overall figure averages the publisher’s own categories, each of which is also indexed on its own.
